subject: Error in part 1: "Cannot open the connection"

messages.author: 5394ffe0c39423c8
messages.subject: Error in part 1: "Cannot open the connection"
parts:
Dear all

I wanted to use my R script of last year to process some extra Axivity files (.cwa), however the script I used last year doesn't seem to run anymore as I encounter an error in part 1... Below you can find the relevant code snippet:

folder_data = "C:/Users/vvoeckel/Documents/Verwerking Axivity data/"
folder_raw = paste0(folder_data, "1_raw/")
folder_ggi = paste0(folder_data, "1_gpart_meta/")

GGIR::g.part1(folder_raw, folder_ggi, f1 = length(dir(folder_raw)),
chunksize = 1, windowsizes = c(1, 900, 3600),
overwrite = FALSE, desiredtz = 'Europe/Brussels')

This is the error I get:

Error in gzfile(file, "wb") : cannot open the connection
In addition: Warning message:
In gzfile(file, "wb") : 
cannot open compressed file 'C:/Users/vvoeckel/Documents/Verwerking Axivity data/1_gpart_meta//meta/basic/meta_621_PRE.cwa.RData', probable reason 'No such file or directory'

I have attempted to troubleshoot the issue by checking package updates, checking the directory existence, verifying permissions, using full file paths in the code (with and without "/" at the end), and testing the code on several files. Unfortunately, the problem persists.

Any insights or suggestions would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you in advance for your assistance!

Kind regards
Veerle Van Oeckel

messages.author: 05de4f382b390d3d
messages.subject: Re: Error in part 1: "Cannot open the connection"
parts:
Hi,

May I ask why are you using g.part1 isolated from the GGIR function? As explained in the documentation, all the functionality from GGIR is expected to be used from the GGIR function. Have you tried to use a simple GGIR function call with only the definition of the datadir and the outputdir? Does this work?

Here an example: https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/GGIR/vignettes/GGIR.html#:~:text=The%20bare%20minimum%20input%20needed%20for%20GGIR%20is%3A

Best,
Jairo

messages.author: 5394ffe0c39423c8
messages.subject: Re: Error in part 1: "Cannot open the connection"
parts:
Dear Jairo

Thank you for your quick response!

To be honest, someone else wrote a script for me, since we wanted to integrate several things into the script that (I think) could not be done or were more difficult to do with GGIR (e.g. we worked with an algorithm that determines types of activities, and did not use cut points for determining levels of physical activity), which made it more complex to write the script (at least for me). So, I'm not 100% sure why g.part1 was run isolated, but based on the comments in the script, I think that's how we wanted to calibrate the data, and determine ENMO and nonwear. The remainder of the script is less based on GGIR, I believe. 

However, after changing the code so that it starts from the GGIR function instead of the gpart.1 function (see below, changes marked in yellow), the code seems to run and the appropriate output appears in the right folder.

GGIR(mode = 1, datadir = folder_raw, outputdir = folder_ggi, f1 = length(dir(folder_raw)),
So, thank you very much for your help!
